description: Paribu brings live crypto market data into ChatGPT. Ask for the current price and 24-hour statistics (change, high, low, volume) of any coin listed on Paribu, in Turkish lira (TL) or USDT. You can also browse markets ranked by trading volume, top gainers and top losers — including sports fan tokens.

defaultPrompt: Show me the top gainers today
List the sports fan tokens by volume
